tools.name: yaohai-catalog
tools.description: List Yaohai / DrugSea databases (60+). Filter by category or keyword to pick a dbname for yaohai-search. Already-marketed China products (国药准字, 批准文号, 上市, 医保/集采) → product-cn-* tools. R&D / CDE pipeline (在研, 受理号, 审评, 尚未上市) → reg-cn-* tools. Other DBs (医保 yibao, 基药 jiyao, 集采 jicai, trials, global) → yaohai-*. Do not use yaohai-search with dbname product_cn or reg_cn when the dedicated tools apply.

category.description: Optional category, e.g. 市场准入, 上市情报, 注册情报, 临床试验, NMPA基础库

q.description: Optional keyword filter on title, id, or keywords

tools.name: yaohai-search
tools.description: Search a single Yaohai database by dbname (from yaohai-catalog). Default limit 10, max 50. One distinct query condition can return at most 1000 rows total (offset+limit window cap, anti-scraping): paginate within that window, or narrow the filters (date / province / ATC / enterprise) to reach deeper slices — a too-large offset is rejected. Use query fields from the catalog's search_fields. Already-marketed China products (国药准字, 批准文号, 上市, 医保/集采) → product-cn-* tools. R&D / CDE pipeline (在研, 受理号, 审评, 尚未上市) → reg-cn-* tools. Other DBs (医保 yibao, 基药 jiyao, 集采 jicai, trials, global) → yaohai-*. Do not use yaohai-search with dbname product_cn or reg_cn when the dedicated tools apply. If total > 20, summarize in chat (about 5–10 sample rows) instead of dumping the full table. Include frontend source links when present. To export Excel: first search and read total; if total is 1–999, call again with action=output. The server counts first, generates xlsx via the list API, uploads it to OSS, and returns download_url (never binary). If total ≥ 1000, narrow the query instead.

dbname.description: Database id, e.g. yibao, jiyao, jicai, jicai_mulu, fda_dmf. Prefer product-cn-search / reg-cn-search instead of product_cn / reg_cn. china_new_drugs and generic_cn are hidden — do not query them.

item.description: Common keyword box (药名/企业/适应症). Most yaohai-search DBs and product-cn / reg-cn use item. Not valid for yaohai-global-search — use top-level q or query.term.

drug_name.description: Chinese generic name when the DB has a dedicated 药名 box.

q.description: Alias rewritten to item on product_cn/reg_cn search, and to term on yaohai-global-search. Prefer the canonical key.

query.description: Search/filter fields. Values may be string, number, or string[] (repeat the key for ConditionSearch multiple). Date: "YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD". Range: "min to max". Additional keys are database-specific (see yaohai-catalog search_fields, *-fields tools, or SKILL.md).

search_mode.description: Optional. Hoisted into query.search_mode if query omits it (1/2/3).

offset.description: Pagination offset (default 0); offset+limit is capped at 1000 rows per query condition

action.description: Set to output to export the current query as Excel. Server returns an OSS download_url, not a binary file.

tools.name: yaohai-detail
tools.description: Fetch one record's detail from a Yaohai database. Requires dbname + encrypted id from yaohai-search items. Skip if catalog says has_detail is false (use list fields instead).

tools.name: yaohai-facets
tools.description: Facet distributions (条件筛选) — aggregated value+count buckets for filterable fields. Works for 56 databases reached via yaohai-search (zhaobiao, ct_cn, yibao, jiyao, jicai, product_us, uk_emc, …), including dedicated-route pages (zhaobiao, ct_cn, product_us, sales_cn, …). DISCOVERY MODE: omit `fields` to list available facet fields (add `dbname` for one db, omit it for all 56). FETCH MODE: pass `fields` (required with `dbname`) to get buckets for those fields. One HTTP request fires per field, so request only the 2–4 you need. Pass the same `query` filters you used in yaohai-search to facet within that result set. High-cardinality drug_name / manufacture (zhaobiao, jicai) need a narrowing query filter first. sales_cn / sales_global return hardcoded SPA lists (count is null). Not available for product_cn / reg_cn — use product-cn-facets / reg-cn-facets instead.

dbname.description: Database id from yaohai-catalog, e.g. zhaobiao, yibao, ct_cn, product_us. Required when `fields` is given. Omit to list all facet-capable databases.

item.description: Common keyword box (药名/企业/适应症). Most yaohai-search DBs and product-cn / reg-cn use item. Not valid for yaohai-global-search — use top-level q or query.term.

drug_name.description: Chinese generic name when the DB has a dedicated 药名 box.

q.description: Alias rewritten to item on product_cn/reg_cn search, and to term on yaohai-global-search. Prefer the canonical key.

query.description: Search/filter fields. Values may be string, number, or string[] (repeat the key for ConditionSearch multiple). Date: "YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD". Range: "min to max". Additional keys are database-specific (see yaohai-catalog search_fields, *-fields tools, or SKILL.md).

fields.description: Facet field keys (see discovery mode). This tool uses `fields`, not `facets` (that name is only on product-cn-facets / reg-cn-facets). Omit to get the catalog instead of buckets. Example for yibao: ["province", "drug_type"].

tools.name: yaohai-global-search
tools.description: Cross-database hit counts for one search term (homepage /search). Use top-level q (or query.term — not query.q). Returns how many matches that term has in each Yaohai database so you can pick which DB to query next (product-cn-search / reg-cn-search / yaohai-search). Not a molecule list; Excel export is not supported. Default top=15 hits (count-desc); pass top=0 for the full list.

q.description: Search term. Same as query.term. Prefer this top-level field over query.q.

term.description: Search term. Aliases item / q / drug_name / keyword are rewritten to term.

query.description: Only term is accepted (item / q / drug_name / keyword are rewritten to term).

top.description: Max hits[] rows, sorted by count descending. Default 15, max 100, 0 = all. Use a small top to route ("which DB?") without the full payload.

tools.name: product-cn-search
tools.description: Search already-marketed China drugs (product_cn / 国药准字 / 批准文号 / NMPA listed). Default search_mode=3 (partial). first_approve_date = first listing date; approve_date = latest re-registration (not first listing). For disease/therapeutic-class queries prefer ConditionSearch ATC_code (letter): L=oncology, C=cardiovascular, J=anti-infectives, N=nervous system, R=respiratory, A=alimentary/metabolism (e.g. diabetes), H=hormones, G=genito-urinary, M=musculo-skeletal, D=dermatologicals, B=blood, S=sensory, P=antiparasitic, V=various. DrugSea extensions (not WHO): Z=中药 (largest bucket), W=原料药, E=辅料. Default limit 20, max 100. One distinct query condition can return at most 1000 rows total (offset+limit window cap, anti-scraping): paginate within that window, or narrow the filters (date / province / ATC / enterprise) to reach deeper slices — a too-large offset is rejected. Not for R&D pipeline — use reg-cn-search. If total > 20, summarize in chat (about 5–10 sample rows) instead of dumping the full table. Include frontend source links when present. To export Excel: first search and read total; if total is 1–999, call again with action=output. The server counts first, generates xlsx via the list API, uploads it to OSS, and returns download_url (never binary). If total ≥ 1000, narrow the query instead.
